description: This is a test source file for a Django REST Framework API. It contains test cases for health check endpoints and CRUD operations on 'Note' objects, including setup for test data, assertions for API responses, and test cases for filtering, pagination, ordering, and validation.

classes.name: HealthTests
classes.description: Test case class for health check endpoint, verifies if the server is up and responds with the expected message.

classes.name: NoteCRUDTests
classes.description: Test case class for CRUD operations and filtering on Note objects, including create, retrieve, update, delete, validation, pagination, filtering, search, and ordering functionalities.

methods.name: test_health(self)
methods.description: Tests the health endpoint to ensure the server responds with a message indicating it is up.

methods.name: setUp(self)
methods.description: Sets up initial Note objects for use in subsequent tests.

methods.name: test_create_note(self)
methods.description: Tests creating a new note via POST request and checks for proper response and data fields.

methods.name: test_validation_error_empty_title(self)
methods.description: Tests validation for empty or whitespace-only title during note creation, expecting a 400 error.

methods.name: test_list_with_pagination_and_filters(self)
methods.description: Tests listing notes with pagination, filtering by archived status, and search functionality.

methods.name: test_retrieve_update_delete(self)
methods.description: Tests retrieving, updating (full and partial), deleting a note, and verifying the appropriate responses.

methods.name: test_ordering(self)
methods.description: Tests ordering notes by title ascending and creation date descending.
